outcome: Incidence of adhesions between omentum and uterus
Surgical difficulty due to severe adhesions
cohort: Women who underwent repeat Cesarean section 1-5 years after initial Cesarean section
finding: Cesarean myomectomy, whether for myolysis or myomectomy, did not significantly increase the risk of postoperative adhesion formation compared to the control group.
mod_finding: Cesarean myomectomy during cesarean section did not significantly increase the risk of postoperative adhesion formation compared to cesarean section alone.
